{{Quote|There'll be no dying in my place! Take your lousy mark and get out!|The [[Unidentified cantina proprietor|cantina's owner]] to [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]]|<ref name="Rebel Escape">{{JournalCite|7|Rebel Escape}}</ref>}}
This '''cantina''' was a particularly crowded and dim cantina whose [[Unidentified cantina proprietor|owner]] was not particularly fond of people being killed in the establishment. Thus, when [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]] entered the premises and murdered a [[Unidentified Rebel courier|patron]], the bartender yelled at Fett to leave the place. Fett paid a considerable sum of money as compensation and announced to the crowd that he was looking for another [[Mari (Courier)|target]] and was willing to pay handsomely for any information that could lead him to her. What he did not know was that she was actually in that very cantina, hiding in the shadows. When he had left, she sneaked out into the streets, but was followed by a group of [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]] who ended up helping her complete the [[Mari's mission|mission]] she was on.

==Behind the scenes==
While as of yet unnamed, this cantina is significant to the plot of ''[[Rebel Escape]]'', as it is the location in which the entire scenario begins.
